effect.name: Chromatic Aberration
effect.description: Splits the red and blue channels apart, the way a cheap lens or a composite cable does. A pinch of it sells "screen", a lot of it sells "something is wrong with the machine".
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Strength
parameter.description: How far apart the channels are pulled, in texels.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: Direction of the split in degrees, used when Radial is off.

parameter.name: Radial
parameter.description: On splits outward from the centre so the edges of the screen suffer most, which is how a lens behaves. Off splits everything the same direction.

parameter.name: Centre Falloff
parameter.description: Radial only: how quickly the split fades out toward the middle of the image.
